scope: Train-only numerical audit, no new external forecasting metric and no HPO

source.license: Binance Vision terms, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 unless otherwise designated; noncommercial research only

cases: Six original outer initial fits: baseline3/all24 for 2023,2024,2025; plus all24 first inner cutoff June29 2022 (88 examples). Only training labels are used. Fixed/adaptive share initial fit.
objective: mean(logaddexp(0,Xw)-y*Xw) + 0.5*l2*sum(w[1:]**2). Intercept unpenalized. Must not confuse loss sum vs mean or C with l2.
methods: central finite differences epsilon1e-6 vs analytic gradient
average gradient from production steps vs analytic batch gradient
SciPy1.15.3 L-BFGS-B with independent log_expit objective and numerical 3-point derivatives, max2000 iterations
chronological production SGD trajectory: epochs0,1,10,100,1000; no external scoring, no selecting epoch via outcomes
gates: abort on solver disagreement, changed prior results/data/spec, clipping >=35, missing originals or expired artifact
epochs10 need not converge: nonconvergence is a diagnostic result, not failed code or proof of causal explanation for test performance
caveats: Not new market evidence, not code correctness proof, not PnL
Converging train objective does not guarantee future generalization
No retuning or rescoring frozen external experiments
